## What the status means

- **live-tested**: the actions were run against the real API with a real account.
- **docs-based**: written from the provider's official documentation and tested against a fake server, but **not run against the real service**. It may contain small mistakes (a field name, a scope). Please [report them](https://github.com/itzzzzzzak/connector-kit/issues/new/choose). Verifying one against a real account and sending the result is one of the most useful contributions you can make: see [writing-connectors.md](writing-connectors.md).

## Actions

### Airtable (`airtable`)

List bases and tables, and read, create, update and delete records.

- `bases.list` (read): List the Airtable bases the token can access.
- `tables.list` (read): List the tables in a base with their fields and field types.
- `records.list` (read): List records in a table.
- `records.get` (read): Get one record by id (starts with "rec").
- `records.create` (write): Create one record in a table.
- `records.update` (write): Update some fields of one record; fields you do not mention are left as they are.
- `records.delete` (destructive): Permanently DELETE one record from a table.

### Asana (`asana`)

Read workspaces, projects and tasks, and create or update tasks.

- `users.get` (read): Get a user.
- `workspaces.list` (read): List the workspaces (and organizations) the token can access.
- `projects.list` (read): List projects in a workspace or team.
- `projects.get` (read): Get one project by gid, with its owner, workspace and notes.
- `projects.tasks.list` (read): List the tasks in a project.
- `tasks.get` (read): Get one task by gid, with notes, assignee, due date and the projects it belongs to.
- `tasks.create` (write): Create a task.
- `tasks.update` (write): Update a task: rename it, change notes, mark it complete, reassign it or change the due date.

### Calendly (`calendly`)

Read the user's event types, scheduled meetings and invitees, and cancel meetings.

- `users.me` (read): Get the authenticated Calendly user.
- `eventTypes.list` (read): List event types (the kinds of meetings people can book, e.g.
- `scheduledEvents.list` (read): List scheduled meetings.
- `scheduledEvents.get` (read): Get one scheduled meeting by its uuid (the last part of its URI).
- `scheduledEvents.invitees.list` (read): List the people invited to a scheduled meeting, with their email and status.
- `scheduledEvents.cancel` (destructive): CANCEL a scheduled meeting.

### ClickUp (`clickup`)

Browse workspaces, spaces, folders and lists; read, create and update tasks.

- `workspaces.list` (read): List the ClickUp workspaces the token can access.
- `spaces.list` (read): List the spaces in a workspace.
- `folders.list` (read): List the folders in a space.
- `lists.list` (read): List the lists inside a folder.
- `lists.folderless.list` (read): List the lists that sit directly in a space, outside any folder.
- `tasks.list` (read): List the tasks in a list (100 per page).
- `tasks.get` (read): Get one task by id: status, assignees, priority, due date, tags and description.
- `tasks.create` (write): Create a task in a list.
- `tasks.update` (write): Update a task: rename it, change its description, status, priority or due date.

### DigitalOcean (`digitalocean`)

Read account details, droplets (servers), domains and DNS records.

- `account.get` (read): Get the DigitalOcean account: email, status, and the droplet limit.
- `droplets.list` (read): List droplets (virtual servers) with their status, size, region and IP addresses.
- `droplets.get` (read): Get one droplet by its numeric id: status, size, region, image, tags and IP addresses.
- `domains.list` (read): List the domains managed in DigitalOcean DNS.
- `domains.records.list` (read): List the DNS records of one domain (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT...).

### Figma (`figma`)

Read file structure and comments, render frames as images, and post comments.

- `me.get` (read): Get the authenticated Figma user (id, handle, email).
- `files.get` (read): Get a Figma file's name, last-modified time and its tree of pages and layers.
- `files.nodes.get` (read): Get specific layers of a file by node id, with their details.
- `images.render` (read): Render layers (frames, components) of a file as images and return temporary image URLs.
- `comments.list` (read): List the comments on a file, with who wrote them and whether they are resolved.
- `comments.create` (write): Post a comment on a file (or reply to one with comment_id).

- `repos.get` (read): Get details about a GitHub repository.

### GitLab (`gitlab`)

Read GitLab.com projects, issues, merge requests and pipelines, and create issues.

- `user.get` (read): Get the authenticated GitLab user (username, name, profile link).
- `projects.list` (read): List GitLab projects.
- `projects.get` (read): Get one project by id or full path: description, default branch, visibility, and counts of stars, forks and open issues.
- `issues.list` (read): List the issues of a project.
- `issues.get` (read): Get one issue of a project by its issue number (iid, the number shown as #12), with description, labels and assignees.
- `issues.create` (write): Create an issue in a project.
- `mergeRequests.list` (read): List the merge requests of a project.
- `pipelines.list` (read): List the CI/CD pipelines of a project, newest first, with their status.

### HubSpot (`hubspot`)

Read CRM contacts, companies and deals, and create or update them.

- `contacts.list` (read): List CRM contacts (people).
- `contacts.get` (read): Get one contact by id, or by email: set idProperty to "email" and contactId to the address.
- `contacts.create` (write): Create a contact.
- `contacts.update` (write): Update properties of an existing contact.
- `companies.list` (read): List CRM companies (organizations).
- `companies.get` (read): Get one company by id, optionally choosing which properties to return.
- `companies.create` (write): Create a company.
- `deals.list` (read): List CRM deals (sales opportunities).
- `deals.get` (read): Get one deal by id, optionally choosing which properties to return (for example dealname, amount, dealstage).
- `deals.create` (write): Create a deal.

### Intercom (`intercom`)

Read contacts and customer conversations (read-only, US region).

- `me.get` (read): Identify the Intercom admin the token belongs to, and the workspace (name, region).
- `contacts.list` (read): List contacts (users and leads) in the workspace.
- `contacts.get` (read): Get one contact by id: email, name, phone, role and custom attributes.
- `conversations.list` (read): List customer conversations, most recent first, with state, assignee and the customer's first message.
- `conversations.get` (read): Get one conversation by id, including the messages in the thread.

### Jira (`jira`)

Search and read Jira Cloud issues and projects; create issues, comment, and move issues through their workflow.

- `myself.get` (read): Get the authenticated Jira user (account id, display name, email).
- `projects.list` (read): List Jira projects the user can see, optionally filtered by name or key.
- `issues.search` (read): Search issues with JQL, e.g.
- `issues.get` (read): Get one issue by key (PROJ-123): summary, status, assignee and the other requested fields.
- `issues.create` (write): Create an issue.
- `comments.create` (write): Add a comment to an issue.
- `transitions.list` (read): List the workflow transitions available for an issue right now (for example To Do -> In Progress).
- `issues.transition` (write): Move an issue through its workflow (for example to In Progress or Done) using a transition id from transitions.list.

### Mailchimp (`mailchimp`)

Read audiences, subscribers and campaigns; add or update a subscriber.

- `ping.get` (read): Check that the Mailchimp credentials and data center work.
- `lists.list` (read): List audiences (Mailchimp calls them lists), with subscriber counts.
- `lists.get` (read): Get one audience by id: name, subscriber, unsubscribe and cleaned counts, and open and click rates.
- `members.list` (read): List the subscribers of an audience.
- `members.get` (read): Get one subscriber of an audience by email address: their status, merge fields (name, phone...) and tags.
- `members.upsert` (write): Add a person to an audience, or update them if they are already there.
- `campaigns.list` (read): List email campaigns with status, send time, recipient count and subject line.
- `campaigns.get` (read): Get one campaign by id: subject, status, recipients and the open and click summary.

### Netlify (`netlify`)

Read sites and deploys, and trigger a new build of a site.

- `user.get` (read): Get the authenticated Netlify user (name, email, number of sites).
- `sites.list` (read): List the Netlify sites the token can see, with their URLs and state.
- `sites.get` (read): Get one site by id (or by its domain, e.g.
- `sites.deploys.list` (read): List a site's deploys, newest first: state, branch, commit, and any error.
- `deploys.get` (read): Get one deploy by id: its state, branch, commit, URLs and error message if it failed.
- `sites.builds.create` (write): Trigger a NEW BUILD (and deploy) of a site from its repository.

### PagerDuty (`pagerduty`)

Read incidents, services, on-call shifts, schedules and escalation policies (read-only, US region).

- `incidents.list` (read): List incidents, newest first.
- `incidents.get` (read): Get one incident by id: title, status, urgency, service, escalation policy and who it is assigned to.
- `services.list` (read): List services (the things that raise incidents) with their status.
- `oncalls.list` (read): List who is on call, with the schedule, escalation policy and shift times.
- `schedules.list` (read): List on-call schedules, optionally filtered by name.
- `escalationPolicies.list` (read): List escalation policies (who gets paged, in what order), optionally filtered by name.
- `users.list` (read): List users in the PagerDuty account, optionally matching a name or email.

### Pipedrive (`pipedrive`)

Read deals, people, organizations and pipelines, and create or update deals and people (API v2).

- `deals.list` (read): List deals (sales opportunities), filtered by owner, person, organization, pipeline, stage or status.
- `deals.get` (read): Get one deal by id: title, value, stage, status, and the linked person and organization ids.
- `deals.create` (write): Create a deal.
- `deals.update` (write): Update a deal: rename it, change its value, move its stage, or mark it won or lost.
- `persons.list` (read): List people (contacts), filtered by owner, organization or deal.
- `persons.get` (read): Get one person by id, with their emails, phone numbers and organization.
- `persons.create` (write): Create a person (contact).
- `organizations.list` (read): List organizations (companies), filtered by owner.
- `organizations.get` (read): Get one organization by id: name, website, industry, size and address.
- `pipelines.list` (read): List the sales pipelines.

### Sentry (`sentry`)

Read organizations, projects, issues and error events (read-only).

- `organizations.list` (read): List the Sentry organizations the token can access, with their slugs.
- `projects.list` (read): List the projects in an organization, with platform and creation date.
- `issues.list` (read): List issues (grouped errors) in an organization.
- `issues.get` (read): Get one issue by id: title, status, how many events and users it affected, first and last seen, and the project.
- `issues.events.list` (read): List the individual error events of an issue, newest first, with tags and user.
- `issues.events.get` (read): Get one event of an issue, including its stack trace and breadcrumbs.

### Slack (`slack`)

List channels, read message history and users, and post messages (posting needs --allow-writes over MCP).

- `conversations.list` (read): List Slack channels the app can see.
- `conversations.history` (read): Read recent messages in a Slack channel (newest first).
- `users.info` (read): Get a Slack user's profile by user id (e.g.
- `chat.postMessage` (write): Post a message to a Slack channel or thread.

### Vercel (`vercel`)

Read teams, projects and deployments, including build state and errors.

- `user.get` (read): Get the authenticated Vercel user.
- `teams.list` (read): List the teams the user belongs to, with their ids (needed as teamId for the other calls).
- `projects.list` (read): List Vercel projects, optionally filtered by name.
- `projects.get` (read): Get one project by id or name: framework, Node version, root directory and build command.
- `deployments.list` (read): List deployments, newest first, with state, target and Git info.
- `deployments.get` (read): Get one deployment by id (dpl_...) or hostname: build state, timings, aliases and the error message if it failed.

### Zendesk (`zendesk`)

Read and search support tickets, comments and users; create tickets and add internal notes or replies.

- `users.me` (read): Get the authenticated Zendesk user (name, email, role).
- `tickets.list` (read): List support tickets.
- `tickets.get` (read): Get one ticket by id: subject, status, priority, requester, assignee and tags.
- `tickets.comments.list` (read): List the comments on a ticket (the conversation), oldest first by default.
- `search` (read): Search tickets, users and organizations with Zendesk query syntax, e.g.
- `tickets.create` (write): Create a ticket.
- `tickets.update` (write): Update a ticket: change status, priority or assignee, and/or add a comment.

### Zoom (`zoom`)

List and read the user's meetings, create meetings, and list cloud recordings (no passcodes or download links are exposed).

- `meetings.list` (read): List a user's meetings.
- `meetings.get` (read): Get one meeting by its numeric id: topic, time, duration, agenda and join link.
- `meetings.create` (write): Create a Zoom meeting.
- `recordings.list` (read): List a user's cloud recordings in a date range (default: the last day).
